precondition: unique structural equality and manual Hash implementation cover the complete MathMatrixElem carrier

variants.transform: omit row/cell order from equality or hash
omit hline/vline axis identity or offset order
omit or conflate row/column gap component
omit one of the five MathMatrixExplicit bits, using column_gap as the canonical physical patch

validity: Every variant must be killed by its pairwise equality and hash witness; a failure in an unrelated pair is non-causal.
